Create the Future with AI Powered and Cloud Connected Enterprise
LTM, a trusted Oracle Cloud Partner, is accelerating the transformation of businesses. Together, we are reimagining the future of work and driving at an unprecedented speed and collaboration. We are not just building businesses; we are transforming them.
By harnessing the power of the cloud and leveraging our decades-long Oracle
partnership
, we are unlocking new dimensions of performance and customer experience. Our
Enclose
and
Infinity
platforms are at the forefront of this transformation, empowering businesses to thrive in the digital age. We aim to lead the industry as the first “AI-Native” Cloud ERP practice, delivering innovative business solutions by embedding, amplifying, innovating, and cultivating AI.
As an Oracle Cloud Partner, we bring deep industry expertise and innovative technologies to deliver advanced solutions that drive growth and customer satisfaction. Explore our comprehensive portfolio on the Oracle Marketplace and discover how we are
creating the future
with AI powered and Cloud connected enterprise.

Industry Solutions That Help Scale
Manufacturing
LTM provides Oracle cloud manufacturing solutions that help businesses optimize their processes and improve efficiency, compliance, and customer experience. These solutions include Direct to Customer, Lightweight Warehouse System, Inventory Tracker, Warehouse Navigation, and more.
Learn more
Banking & Financial Services
Our Oracle banking solutions accelerate digital transformation and enhance customer experience. Solutions include Sub-Broker Payment, Merchant Onboarding, and Loan Processing.
Learn more
Oil & Gas
Our purpose-built solutions improve refinery's inventory planning with mass-balance dashboards and automate the hydrocarbon supply chain, from terminal to outlet, addressing critical business challenges.
Learn more
Utilities
Our Oracle energy and utilities solutions meet evolving sector demands with offerings like AMI, billing, network management, asset management, and demand response systems.
Learn more
Public Sector
Our Oracle CX solutions for the public sector include e-governance, tax reconciliation, and case management, driving digital transformation while improving citizen services, transparency, and governance.
Learn more
Insurance
Our Oracle solutions optimize insurance operations, including policy administration, claims management, underwriting automation, and customer engagement platforms.
Learn more
Life Sciences
Our Oracle life sciences solutions facilitate direct-to-patient trials, ensure drug-batch validity, and improve batch control and tracking throughout the supply chain lifecycle.
Learn more
Engineering & Construction
Oracle construction cloud services streamline project management, scheduling, cost control, and collaboration, optimizing resources and increasing stakeholder engagement.
Learn more
Media & Entertainment
Oracle media services streamline content creation, distribution, rights management, and analytics, boosting monetization and audience engagement.
Learn more
Retail
Oracle retail services enhance efficiency, margins, and sales with solutions like merchandise management, supply chain, and retail analytics tailored for various retail formats.
